name: Imakane (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Imakane town emblem in white: a ring enclosing a stylised triangle, forming a stylised character.
history: Municipal flag of Imakane, a town in Hokkaido; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 1 October 1967.

features.role: Imakane town emblem — a ring enclosing a stylised triangle, forming a stylised character
